lines.text: ご飯の冷凍は、炊きたてがいいって知ってた？
prompts: a bright cheerful kitchen with a steaming rice cooker on a wooden counter, bright daylight, simple storybook illustration
a bowl of fluffy white steaming rice, bright daylight, cheerful

lines.text: 冷めたご飯は、デンプンが硬くなっていくと言われています。
prompts: a bowl of cold rice on a table, soft bright daylight, simple storybook illustration
close-up of rice grains looking dry and firm in a bowl, bright daylight

lines.text: これは「老化」と呼ばれる、ご飯が固くなる現象なんです。
prompts: a gentle kitchen scene with a small bowl of hard rice and a calm adult cook looking at it, bright daylight

lines.text: 炊きたてをすぐラップで包むと、水分が閉じ込められます。
prompts: an adult cook wrapping a portion of hot steaming rice in plastic wrap, bright kitchen, storybook style
neat small wrapped rice portions on a tray, bright daylight

lines.text: そのまま冷凍すれば、ふっくら感が保ちやすいんですね。
prompts: wrapped rice portions placed in a freezer with soft blue glow, bright and cheerful, simple illustration
a fluffy bowl of reheated rice with steam, bright daylight

lines.text: 食べる時は、電子レンジでしっかり温めましょう。
prompts: a microwave oven in a bright kitchen with a rice portion inside, cheerful storybook illustration
an adult enjoying a bowl of warm fluffy rice at a table, bright daylight

lines.text: フォローして、次の雑学も受け取ってね！
prompts: a cozy bright kitchen with a bowl of steaming rice and a gentle smile, storybook illustration, bright daylight
